D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonModes.charpoly_factored
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem charpoly_factored (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) : (jacobian (2 * m)).charpoly = X ^ 2 * (X ^ 2 + C ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)) * (X ^ 2 + C (((m : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 / 4)) ^ 2 * ∏ r ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (X ^ 2 - C (((m : ℝ) - r) ^ 2 * ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2) / 4)) ^ 2

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonModes.charpoly_folded
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem charpoly_folded (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) : (jacobian (2 * m)).charpoly = X ^ 2 * (X ^ 2 + C ((m : ℝ) ^ 2 / 2)) * ∏ r ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, (X ^ 2 - C (((m : ℝ) - r) ^ 2 * ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2) / 4)) ^ 2
